item.title: Pentagon prepares for weeks of ground operations in Iran
item.summary: If President Trump approves the plans, such an effort would mark a new phase of the war that could be significantly more dangerous to U.S. troops than the first four weeks.

item.title: Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen attack Israel for first time in war
item.summary: The missile attack by the Houthis in Yemen marks an escalation of the war in the Middle East and may pose further risks to shipping in the region.

item.title: Outrage grows over Israeli restrictions to Jerusalem sites during Holy Week
item.summary: In a rare about-face, the move by Israeli police to block Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa from the holiest site in Christianity was reversed after criticism.

item.title: U.S. allows Russian oil tanker to reach Cuba, breaking Trump’s effective blockade
item.summary: The administration had threatened to punish countries that attempted to break the blockade, which was aimed at weakening the communist government.

item.title: Israel targets Iran’s leaders with lethal expertise using new AI platform
item.summary: The division of responsibility has left Israel to hunt and kill Iranian leaders ruthlessly, using an intelligence apparatus built up to assassinate with lethal proficiency.
